title: Prefixed multiline expense is dropped and idle recaps repeat completed finance exchanges
original_report: Telegram accepted only one expense from 'Запиши 130 отдых\n64 грн продукты', then sent an unnecessary and partly hallucinated conversation recap after 30 minutes.
discovery_scope: Telegram orchestration expense parsing and confirmation payload construction
Shared conversation summary worker and existing shared-memory tests
expected: One confirmation contains both expenses, and no 30-minute conversation recap is created or delivered.
actual: Only the explicit-currency line was confirmed, and the idle worker delivered a recap that reprocessed completed finance commands.
environment: Windows, project virtual environment, Python 3.14, pytest 9
reproduction: Focused async tests exercise the real orchestrator path with the screenshot input and the persisted shared-message delivery path after two idle hours.
failure_signal: The confirmation payload had one item instead of two, and deliver_due_shared_summaries returned 1 instead of 0.
root_cause: The optional-currency multiline pattern required each line to begin with an amount, so the 'Запиши' prefix hid the first item. Separately, the summary worker unconditionally created and delivered conversation-kind summaries after the idle threshold.
fix_summary: Normalize known expense command prefixes before parsing each line, and restrict proactive summary delivery to daily summaries only.
why_causal: Prefix normalization exposes the hidden first amount to the existing validated line parser. Removing conversation-kind summaries from the delivery path prevents both new and previously pending idle recaps from reaching Telegram.
